## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change and why? Link related issues: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` / `perf` / `style`
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` after the type, plus a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## Test plan

<!-- How was this verified? Commands run, screenshots, manual steps. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and every check passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, comments) is updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data are included.
- [ ] Commits are signed.
